description: Create projectRegistry.js — pure localStorage CRUD for the projects list
steps: File exists at apps/web/src/core/project/projectRegistry.js
Exports listProjects() returning an array of { id, name, createdAt, updatedAt } objects from localStorage key 'rack-editor:projects-registry'
Exports createProject(name?) that generates a crypto.randomUUID() id, writes to registry, and returns the new project
Exports updateProject(id, fields) that merges fields into the existing entry and updates updatedAt
Exports deleteProject(id) that removes the registry entry (does not touch the CAD cache key)
No React imports — this is a pure utility module

description: Create useProjectRegistry.js — React hook that subscribes to the projects list with cross-tab sync
steps: File exists at apps/web/src/core/project/useProjectRegistry.js
Hook returns { projects, createProject, updateProject, deleteProject }
Uses useState and a 'storage' event listener so the list re-renders when another tab creates or deletes a project
Calls listProjects() from projectRegistry.js on mount and on storage events
No direct localStorage access — delegates to projectRegistry.js functions

description: Create ProjectsListPage.js — the /projects UI with project cards, new project button, and empty state
steps: File exists at apps/web/src/apps/projects/components/ProjectsListPage.js
Displays a grid or list of project cards using data from useProjectRegistry
Each card shows: project name, creation date, and an 'Open' button that navigates to /project/[id]/design
Each card has a Delete button that calls deleteProject(id) after a confirmation (window.confirm or similar)
A 'New Project' button calls createProject() and immediately navigates to /project/[id]/design
When no projects exist, shows an empty state with a prominent 'Create your first project' CTA
Matches the visual style of the existing workspace (uses existing CSS variables and design tokens)

description: Create app/(workspace)/projects/page.js — the /projects list route
steps: File exists at apps/web/app/(workspace)/projects/page.js
Renders <ProjectsListPage /> from apps/projects/components/ProjectsListPage.js
Navigating to /projects in the browser shows the projects list page
The page is wrapped by AppWorkspaceLayout (inherited from the (workspace) group layout)

description: Create ProjectWorkspaceTabs.js — horizontal tab strip with Design, Quote, and 3D tabs
steps: File exists at apps/web/src/shared/components/common/ProjectWorkspaceTabs.js
Accepts props: { projectId, activePath }
Renders three tab links: Design → /project/[id]/design, Quote → /project/[id]/quote, 3D → /project/[id]/3d
The active tab is visually distinguished (underline accent or similar) based on activePath
3D tab is styled as 'coming soon' (e.g. dimmed, with a 'Soon' badge) but still navigable
Uses Next.js <Link> for navigation — no full page reloads

description: Create app/(workspace)/project/[id]/layout.js — shared layout that renders the tab bar above project workspace pages
steps: File exists at apps/web/app/(workspace)/project/[id]/layout.js
Reads the project id from params
Reads the project name from useProjectRegistry (falls back to 'Project' if not found)
Renders <ProjectWorkspaceTabs projectId={id} activePath={pathname} /> above {children}
Sits inside the (workspace) group layout so AppRailNav is still rendered on the left
Children fill the remaining vertical height

description: Create app/(workspace)/project/[id]/design/page.js — the Design tab route that renders CadWorkspacePage
steps: File exists at apps/web/app/(workspace)/project/[id]/design/page.js
Renders <CadWorkspacePage projectId={params.id} />
Navigating to /project/abc123/design loads the CAD editor for project 'abc123'
The tab bar is visible above the CAD canvas (from the layout)

description: Update CadWorkspacePage.js to accept a projectId prop and use it as the storage scope key instead of hardcoded 'main'
steps: CadWorkspacePage accepts a projectId prop
All calls to loadCachedProjectDocument and cacheProjectDocument use projectId instead of the hardcoded string 'main'
After each auto-save, calls updateProject(projectId, { updatedAt: new Date().toISOString() }) to touch the registry entry
Existing behavior is preserved when projectId is 'main' (backward compat)
No other internals of CadWorkspacePage are changed

description: Create app/(workspace)/project/[id]/quote/page.js — the Quote tab route that renders QuoterPage
steps: File exists at apps/web/app/(workspace)/project/[id]/quote/page.js
Renders <QuoterPage projectId={params.id} />
Navigating to /project/abc123/quote loads the Quoter for project 'abc123'
The tab bar is visible above the quoter (from the layout)

description: Update QuoterPage.js to accept a projectId prop and use project-scoped quote storage with backward compat for cadQuoteTransfer
steps: QuoterPage accepts a projectId prop
Quote persistence key is 'rack-editor:project:{projectId}:quote' when projectId is provided
On first mount for a project, checks for a pending cadQuoteTransfer payload in sessionStorage, consumes and migrates it, then clears the key
Falls back to old cadQuoteTransfer key on first load so existing data is not lost
No other internals of QuoterPage are changed

description: Create ThreeDPlaceholderPage.js — a centered 'Coming Soon' card for the 3D tab
steps: File exists at apps/web/src/apps/three-d/components/ThreeDPlaceholderPage.js
Renders a centered card with a 3D/box icon (e.g. Lucide Box icon)
Displays the heading '3D Renderer — Coming Soon'
Displays a short description: 'A three-dimensional view of your rack layout will appear here.'
Matches the visual style of the workspace

description: Create app/(workspace)/project/[id]/3d/page.js — the 3D tab route
steps: File exists at apps/web/app/(workspace)/project/[id]/3d/page.js
Renders <ThreeDPlaceholderPage />
Navigating to /project/abc123/3d shows the Coming Soon placeholder
The tab bar is visible above the placeholder (from the layout)

description: Update AppRailNav.js to replace the CAD and Quoter nav items with a single Projects item
steps: AppRailNav no longer shows separate CAD and Quoter rail icons
A single 'Projects' nav item with a folder icon links to /projects
The Projects item is highlighted (active state) when pathname starts with '/project' or '/projects'
All other nav items remain unchanged

description: Update app/(workspace)/page.js to redirect to /projects instead of rendering the CAD editor directly
steps: Navigating to the workspace root (/) redirects to /projects
Uses Next.js redirect() or a client-side router.replace('/projects')
Existing direct links to /editor still work (redirected to /projects)
The CAD editor is now only accessible via /project/[id]/design

description: Update app/(workspace)/quoter/page.js to redirect to /projects
steps: Navigating to /quoter redirects to /projects
Uses Next.js redirect() or a client-side router.replace('/projects')
app/(workspace)/quoter/[id]/page.js (if it exists) is kept with a @deprecated comment
The Quoter is now only accessible via /project/[id]/quote

description: Auto-migrate existing 'main' project data to the registry on first visit to /projects
steps: On load of the /projects page, if no projects exist in the registry but 'rack-editor:project:main' is present in localStorage, a project named 'My First Project' with id 'main' is automatically created in the registry
After migration, the project appears in the list and opens correctly via /project/main/design
Migration runs only once — subsequent visits do not re-migrate
Users with no prior data see an empty state with the 'Create your first project' CTA

description: Merge the 36px project-name header and the 44px tab bar in the project workspace layout into a single 44px bar
steps: The separate <header> element (36px, showing project name) is removed from apps/web/app/(workspace)/project/[id]/layout.js
ProjectWorkspaceTabs accepts an additional optional projectName prop

When projectName is provided, ProjectWorkspaceTabs renders it as a non-interactive label on the left side of the bar, before the tab links, styled with: fontSize 12, fontWeight 500, color var(--muted-text), paddingRight 12, borderRight '1px solid var(--surface-border)', marginRight 12
layout.js passes the resolved projectName (from useProjectRegistry, falling back to 'Project') into ProjectWorkspaceTabs
The total fixed chrome above page content is now 44px instead of 80px (36 + 44)
The tab bar's own bottom border-bottom separator is preserved

description: Restyle the ProjectWorkspaceTabs active/inactive tab indicators to use filled pill buttons instead of underlines, making them visually distinct from the EditorPanel sidebar tab strip
steps: In apps/web/src/shared/components/common/ProjectWorkspaceTabs.js, the active tab link renders with: background 'var(--accent, #3b82f6)', color '#ffffff', borderRadius 6, padding '0 12px', fontWeight 600, and no bottom-border highlight
Inactive (non-coming-soon) tabs render with: background transparent, color 'var(--muted-text)', fontWeight 500, and no bottom border
The tab bar container's own borderBottom separator ('1px solid var(--surface-border)') is kept unchanged
The coming-soon 3D tab keeps its dimmed opacity (0.6) and 'Soon' badge regardless of the new active style

The result is visually distinct from the EditorPanel sidebar tabs, which use a blue underline (borderBottom: '2px solid #3b82f6') on a grey background — the top nav now uses filled pill buttons on a flat bar

description: Auto-populate the BOM Quoter from the saved CAD project document every time the Quote tab is opened, by adding a useEffect in QuoterPage.js
steps: apps/web/src/apps/quoter/components/QuoterPage.js imports loadCachedProjectDocument from '@/src/apps/cad/services/project/projectStorage'
apps/web/src/apps/quoter/components/QuoterPage.js imports deriveBomFromCadProject and buildCatalogResolver from '@/src/apps/quoter/services/cadImportService'
apps/web/src/apps/quoter/components/QuoterPage.js imports getQuoteStore from '@/src/apps/cad/services/cadStores'

A new useEffect (depending on projectId) runs on mount: calls loadCachedProjectDocument(projectId); if a document is returned, derives the BOM and calls getQuoteStore().syncFromBom(bom, { resolveCatalog: buildCatalogResolver(bom.items), projectFile: projectId })
If loadCachedProjectDocument returns null, or if deriveBomFromCadProject throws, the effect exits silently — the quoter shows whatever BOM was already in the store
The effect runs after the existing sessionStorage cadQuoteTransfer check so project-scoped CAD data takes precedence over legacy transfer payloads
No changes are made to CadWorkspacePage.js or the 'Send to Quoter' button in this task
Navigating from the Design tab to the Quote tab — with no button click — shows a BOM derived from the most recently auto-saved CAD state for that project

description: Simplify handleSendToQuoter in CadWorkspacePage.js to navigate to the Quote tab only, now that QuoterPage auto-syncs the BOM on mount
steps: Prerequisite: task auto-bom-sync-on-quote-tab passes
In apps/web/src/apps/cad/CadWorkspacePage.js, handleSendToQuoter removes the serializeProjectDocument, deriveBomFromCadProject, buildCatalogResolver, and getQuoteStore().syncFromBom() calls
handleSendToQuoter now only calls router.push('/project/' + projectId + '/quote') to navigate to the Quote tab
The try/catch block and window.alert error handler that wrapped the old sync logic are also removed
The 'Send to Quoter' button in EditorPanel remains visible and still navigates to the Quote tab — it is not removed
Imports in CadWorkspacePage.js that are no longer used after this change (deriveBomFromCadProject, buildCatalogResolver, getQuoteStore) are removed if no other code in the file uses them
